name: Mew
flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe MEW to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

levelUp.name: Pound
levelUp.description: The foe is physically pounded with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.

levelUp.name: Transform
levelUp.description: The user transforms into a copy of the foe right down to having the same move set.

levelUp.name: Mega Punch
levelUp.description: The foe is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

levelUp.name: Metronome
levelUp.description: The user waggles a finger and stimulates the brain into randomly using nearly any move.

levelUp.name: Psychic
levelUp.description: The foe is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

levelUp.name: Barrier
levelUp.description: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.

levelUp.name: Amnesia
levelUp.description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

levelUp.name: Me First
levelUp.description: The user tries to cut ahead of the foe to steal and use the foe’s intended move with greater power.

levelUp.name: Hidden Power, Ice Beam, Dark Pulse, Aura Sphere
Baton Pass
levelUp.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.

levelUp.name: Nasty Plot
levelUp.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk.

levelUp.name: Aura Sphere
levelUp.description: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body. This move is certain to hit.

tutor.name: Dive
tutor.description: A two-turn attack. The user dives underwater on the first turn, then hits on the next turn.

tutor.name: Fury Cutter
tutor.description: The foe is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.

tutor.name: Icy Wind
tutor.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

tutor.name: Rollout
tutor.description: The user continually rolls into the foe over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

tutor.name: Fire Punch
tutor.description: The foe is punched with a fiery fist. It may leave the target with a burn.

tutor.name: Superpower
tutor.description: The user attacks the foe with great power. However, it also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense.

tutor.name: Ice Punch
tutor.description: The foe is punched with an icy fist. It may leave the target frozen.

tutor.name: Iron Head
tutor.description: The foe slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.

tutor.name: Aqua Tail
tutor.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

tutor.name: Ominous Wind
tutor.description: The user creates a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

tutor.name: Gastro Acid
tutor.description: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the foe. The fluid eliminates the effect of the foe’s ability.

tutor.name: Snore
tutor.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

tutor.name: Spite
tutor.description: The user looses its grudge on the move last used by the foe by cutting 4 PP from it.

tutor.name: Air Cutter
tutor.description: The user launches razorlike wind to slash the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

tutor.name: Helping Hand
tutor.description: A move that boosts the power of the ally’s attack in a Double Battle.

tutor.name: Endeavor
tutor.description: An attack move that cuts down the foe’s HP to equal the user’s HP.

tutor.name: Outrage
tutor.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. However, it then becomes confused.

tutor.name: Synthesis
tutor.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

tutor.name: Signal Beam
tutor.description: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.

tutor.name: Zen Headbutt
tutor.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and rams the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

tutor.name: Vacuum Wave
tutor.description: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the foe. This move always goes first.

tutor.name: Earth Power
tutor.description: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

tutor.name: Gunk Shot
tutor.description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the foe to attack. It may also poison the target.

tutor.name: Twister
tutor.description: The user whips up a vicious twister to tear at the foe. It may also make the foe flinch.

tutor.name: Seed Bomb
tutor.description: The user slams a barrage of hard- shelled seeds down on the foe from above.

tutor.name: Iron Defense
tutor.description: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

tutor.name: Magnet Rise
tutor.description: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

tutor.name: Last Resort
tutor.description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

tutor.name: Bounce
tutor.description: The user bounces up high, then drops on the foe on the second turn. It may also paralyze the foe.

tutor.name: Trick
tutor.description: The user catches the foe off guard and swaps the foe’s held item with its own.

tutor.name: Heat Wave
tutor.description: The user exhales a heated breath on the foe to attack. It may also leave the target with a burn.

tutor.name: Knock Off
tutor.description: The user slaps down the foe’s held item, preventing the item from being used during the battle.

tutor.name: Sucker Punch
tutor.description: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the foe is not readying an attack, however.

tutor.name: Swift
tutor.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the foe. This attack never misses.

tutor.name: Uproar
tutor.description: The user attacks in an uproar for two to five turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.
